items.prompt: What must accompany an empirical VaR/ES number before it is useful for judging portfolio risk?
items.modelAnswer: Loss sign, currency/notional, horizon, confidence, quantile/ES convention, scenario probabilities/window/coverage, position and valuation model,tail uncertainty/liquidity/regime/stress limitations. Exact sample arithmetic is not future coverage or a maximum-loss/capital-compliance guarantee.

criteria.text: Preserves tail uncertainty and no guarantee.
